content: Good morning, this is Ashley Carter from the IRS Appeals Department. We're contacting you regarding a recent issue found with your tax filings.
Um, hi. I just graduated and started working, so what kind of issue are you talking about?

According to our records, your Social Security number has been flagged due to possible discrepancies in your recent tax returns. Have you been notified before about any suspicious activity on your taxes?
No, this is the first time I've heard anything like this. I did my taxes online this year.
I see. Unfortunately, the IRS has placed a temporary suspension on your Social Security number, which means any further use could be treated as fraudulent. It's imperative we clear this up quickly.
Wait, my Social Security number is suspended? Does that mean I can't use it for anything?

That's correct. The suspension will remain until we verify your identity and resolve the tax irregularities. If we don't act soon, your case may be handed over to federal authorities for further action.
Oh, wow. Am I in trouble? I didn't do anything wrong.

At this stage, we're trying to help you avoid any legal consequences such as fines or arrest. As the appeals supervisor, I can offer you a one-time settlement option to reinstate your Social Security number and close this matter.
What do I have to do to fix this?
You will need to verify your identity and cover a reinstatement fee of $1,486. This is required to stop further escalation and to unlock your Social Security record.
Okay... how am I supposed to pay that fee?
For your security and to ensure immediate processing, we can only accept payment through electronic methods. You may use Zelle, CashApp, or Google Pay. Would you like the account details to proceed?
Um, I guess. Can you send me the info?

Certainly. Please send the payment to Zelle using the email appeals.settlement@irs-case.com or to CashApp at $IRSResolution2024. Once you have completed the transaction, provide me with the confirmation code so we can finalize your reinstatement.
Okay, I'll try to do that now. Is there a deadline?
Yes, you must complete the payment within the next 30 minutes, or your case will be referred to the federal claims unit. This could result in wage garnishments or a hold on your bank account.
This is a lot. What happens after I pay?
Once payment is received and verified, your Social Security number will be fully reinstated and you will receive an official IRS clearance letter within 24 hours.
Alright. I'm sending it to the Zelle address now.
Excellent. Please let me know as soon as you've completed the transaction and provide the confirmation number so I can expedite your file.
I just sent it. My confirmation number is 8362XM1.
Thank you. I'm checking our system now. Please stay on the line while I verify your payment.
